items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I think I played a few jobs along with Tom

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Tom and I used to go to school together too. We started.

I think I played a few jobs along with Tom, and he got him in a lot of it. And he plays a lot of Dixieland stuff. He had a guy play a trumpet with him, his last name is Joseph, I don't know his name, he's crippled. Well that's Frost.
